translations.english: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.
translations.hindi: यह दैवताओं के सैन्यरूपी महासागर में घुसकर ओर देवराज को पकड़कर, उन्हें लङ्का के बंदीगह में डाल चुका है
